steps.content:
Late at night
The Fifth Avenue, Eastside
Several figures appeared on the rooftop of the exhibition center.
The center had become the eye of a storm, thanks to the paradoxical tagline, "a painting not from this world," which alone had sent the public into a frenzy.
The real catalyst, however, was a calling card from a notorious criminal group declaring their intent to steal it.

The public was in an uproar, terrified that these blood-chilling Sinners had turned into mere thrill-seekers. Yet the gallery owner paid no heed to the calling card, instead using it for publicity to attract even more visitors.
The man even boasted to the press, "Let them try. My system is impenetrable!"

steps.speaker: Curator
steps.content: "You know Fox and Rabbit? Even if those washed-up legends crawled out of retirement, they wouldn't get past my lobby!"
Recalling the man's smug face from the news, Kisugi Ai rolled her eyes.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: A guy like that? Can he really take proper care of those precious artworks?
The three sisters secured their ropes and slipped through a rooftop ventilation shaft. It wasn't long before they emerged outside the exhibition hall.
Their view inside revealed multiple encrypted doors and a blatantly visible infrared security grid, a sight that drew a wry smile from each of them.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Ai, this is your part. Can you handle it?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Leave it to me! I checked everything out when I came to visit earlier!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: There were way too many people back then. I wanted to see the painting, but I couldn't even squeeze through the crowd.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: But hey, it gave me the perfect chance to note all the cameras and security devices!
Kisugi Ai cracked all three encryption layers the moment the words were spoken. The doors swung open with a heavy thunk.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: You've gotten much faster, Ai.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Hehe, I don't know what it is lately. I've just been on fire!
Kisugi Rui gave Ai an affectionate pat on the head, then slipped into the exhibition hall with Kisugi Hitomi.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Ready, girls?

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Let's do this!
It was apparent that the curator had either ignored the calling card or vastly overestimated his defenses.

Methodically, Kisugi Rui and Hitomi disabled the cameras with targeted jammers. Next, leveraging Kisugi Ai's external connection, they rewrote the infrared security protocols, turning the lethal grids into inert, touchable decorations.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: It worked, Ai! You're amazing!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Of course! I've got everything covered!

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: But just to be safe, I didn't touch the main terminal here. So the two devices closest to the painting are still active.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Hitomi, be careful.
Kisugi Rui handed her younger sister a hair tie. Hitomi then swept her beautiful long black hair up, with Rui looking on.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: I will! Leave this to me!
The infrared beams grew denser the nearer she got to the painting. But Hitomi moved with remarkable agility, slipping past the searing lines of defense with flawless precision.
After landing in the center, she even flashed a quick victory sign to her sisters outside.
However... the moment she got a clear look at the painting itself...

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Several days ago, the Jadox Exhibition Center on the Fifth Avenue received a calling card from the notorious serial offender known as "Cat's Eye." The gallery owner remained supremely confident that Cat's Eye could never breach his security and steal the Otherland Angels.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: But today, the Jadox Exhibition Center discovered clear signs of intrusion, all leading to the display of the Otherland Angels.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: While it is already clear that the security protecting the masterpiece Otherland Angels has been breached…

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: The culprit left without taking the painting.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Upon re-examination, the piece was confirmed to be a forgery.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Following news of this Cat's Eye incident, the number of people claiming to own the real Otherland Angels continues to grow.
The three sisters were left puzzled by the unexpected public reaction.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: Either way, we need to learn more about this world before deciding our next move.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Rui
steps.content: We should focus on major exhibitions and reputable galleries first. Those private collectors making the loudest claims right now probably don't have the real thing.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Yeah, most of them are just like that exhibition center's curator, opportunists looking to profit.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Hitomi
steps.content: Anyway, let's start sorting through the leads!
On the television, the news report continued. The camera panned across the exhibition hall, catching a gray-haired man as he stepped into the corner of the frame and flashed a badge at the police.
steps.female_content: On the television, the news report continued. The camera panned across the exhibition hall, catching a gray-haired woman as she stepped into the corner of the frame and flashed a badge at the police.

steps.speaker: Kisugi Ai
steps.content: Is that person... with the police? Doesn't really look like an officer...
